{{Quote|But sir, the Hoth system is supposed to be devoid of Human forms.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''Hoth system''' was a remote [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Episode 5" /> located on the fringe of the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], at the edge of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031204hoth|text=Hoth: Under the Ice|int=Hoth: Under the Ice}}</ref> The Hoth system was the one-time location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]; and in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], a crushing defeat of the Rebellion by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

The system comprised six [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including a wide and chaotic [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] at the farthest [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Debris from this belt caused substantial [[Asteroid/Legends|meteorite]] activity on the planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="GG3" />
